authority_scope: current whole-fortress grants; preauthorize the whole requested positive horizon when initially unpaused; recheck at every frontier
zero_tick_behavior: evaluate the current snapshot without requiring a prior committed action or clock authority
publication: fit complete initial watch result and current game work before any progression
persist every accepted game frontier or expose a durability fence before returning
prepare the exact watch candidate against that published frontier
render complete current anchors, retained baseline and watch catalogs, pending plans, actions, obligations, and selected evidence before committing the watch root
return the admitted Agent Turn unchanged; no facade refit
late refusal leaves the new watch candidate uncommitted while retaining real prior game time; authorized errors preserve last accepted sample separately from current world

budgets.source_cost: checked accumulated canonical records and bytes
budgets.refusals: current owning byte/token caps; standard explicit irreducible-error exception below the minimal JSON envelope
